description: This file defines the interface IDecryptionService for a media decryption service within the Rialto server component. It declares virtual methods for decrypting media buffers, checking key system type, selecting key IDs, and managing session usage counters.
external_methods: MediaKeyErrorStatus decrypt(int32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstCaps*)

classes.name: IDecryptionService
classes.description: An interface class for media decryption services, providing methods for decrypting media, key management, and session usage tracking.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted media buffers, with an overload for additional parameters.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key session uses the PlayReady key system.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a session ID.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a session ID.

calls: MediaKeyErrorStatus decrypt(int32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstCaps*)
